title: Tidy R Wrapper for Python's CodeCarbon Emissions Tracker
text: Think like time benchmarking packages tictok microbenchmark. start tracker stop tracker. Everything remains . tidycarbon measure machine backend. Emissions data automatically logged emissions.csv root project folder. Unless otherwise specified, emissions results always appended file.
code: library(tidycarbon)  # First, initiate the carbon tracking engine.  tracker <- carbon_init(project_name = "Fridays for Future")  # Second, start the tracker. tracker_start(tracker)  # Next, write your R code here (supports tidyverse, parallel, topicmodels, quanteda, ...everything) library(dplyr) iris %>%   select(Sepal.Length) %>%   pull() %>%   sum()  # Finally, stop the tracker.  tracker_stop(tracker)

title: Tidy R Wrapper for Python's CodeCarbon Emissions Tracker
text: little different time benchmarking package. one main use-cases emissions tracker measure carbon footprint heavy computational processes machine learning language models, carbon_track functions track emissions specific function list functions. Returns tidy tibble task id, function results, metadata, emissions, energy, hardware, geo data:
code: library(tidycarbon)  # First, initiate the carbon tracking engine.  tracker <- carbon_init(project_name = "Fridays for Future")  # Next, define your function(s) square <- function(x) x^2  # Then, track a single function carbon_track(square, x = 42, tracker = tracker)  # Or, track multiple functions tasks <- list(   list(fun = square, args = list(x = 2)),   list(fun = square, args = list(x = 3)) ) carbon_track_all(tasks, tracker)  # Finally, stop the tracker.  tracker_stop(tracker) # A tibble: 1 × 35   project_name run_id ... emissions_total cpu_power ...   <chr>        <chr>  ...           <dbl>      <dbl> ...

title: Tidy R Wrapper for Python's CodeCarbon Emissions Tracker
text: carbon_init(): Create CodeCarbon tracker. tracker_start() / tracker_stop(): Global run tracking. carbon_track(fun, ..., tracker): Track single function. carbon_track_all(tasks, tracker): Batch track list tasks. carbon_view(): Starts Shiny dashboard localhost (development)
